description: Fix dashboard.js 'isAdmin is not defined' error by adding isAdmin() helper function to auth.js. The function should return true if getRole() === 'Admin', false otherwise. Dashboard.js line 8 calls isAdmin() but it doesn't exist.
steps: Read wwwroot/js/auth.js to confirm isAdmin() is missing
Add function isAdmin() at end of auth.js that returns getRole() === 'Admin'
Add JSDoc comment: @returns {boolean} - True if current user is Admin
acceptance_criteria: Function returns boolean based on role check
Dashboard page loads for Member without console error
verification: Open browser console - verify no 'isAdmin is not defined' error
Page renders successfully with member dashboard stats
findings: Added isAdmin() function to auth.js that returns boolean based on getRole() === 'Admin' check. Function includes JSDoc comment. Dashboard.js line 8 will now successfully call isAdmin() without 'is not defined' error.
